title.rendered: SKVST POSTERS RELEASED

content.rendered:
Tirupati, 10 February 2017: TTD EO Dr D Sambasiva Rao released the posters of annual brahmotsavams of Sri Kalyana Venkateswara Swamy of Srinivasa Mangapuram in his chambers in TTD administrative building on Friday.

The annual event will commence on February 16 and concludes on February 24 with Garuda Seva on February 20, Rathotsavam on February 23 and Chakrasnanam on final day.

DLO Sri Venkataramana, Temple DyEO Sri Venkataiah was also present.

ISSUED BY THE PUBLIC RELATIONS OFFICER TTDs TIRUPATI
